shops.name: Kiln & Leaf
shops.tagline: Small-batch stoneware and loose-leaf tea from a two-person studio

products.title: Speckled stoneware tea mug
products.summary: Wheel-thrown 12 oz mug with an oatmeal speckle glaze.
products.description: Wheel-thrown stoneware mug, 12 oz, finished in a speckled oatmeal glaze with a raw clay foot. Each one is a little different. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

products.title: House chai, loose leaf (100 g tin)
products.summary: Assam black tea with cardamom, ginger, cinnamon and clove.
products.description: Our house chai: Assam black tea blended in small batches with green cardamom, ginger, cinnamon and clove. About 40 cups per 100 g tin.

products.title: Ceramic tea strainer
products.summary: Hand-pierced stoneware strainer that rests on any mug.
products.description: Hand-pierced stoneware strainer with a wide rim that rests on most mugs, plus a small matching drip dish. Pairs with any loose-leaf tea.

products.title: Beeswax pillar candle
products.summary: Hand-poured pure beeswax, about 40 hours of burn.
products.description: Hand-poured pillar of pure beeswax with a cotton wick. Smells faintly of honey; about 40 hours of burn time.

products.title: Large stoneware teapot
products.summary: Six-cup teapot with a built-in strainer.
products.description: Six-cup stoneware teapot with a built-in ceramic strainer and a speckled oatmeal glaze to match our mugs.

products.title: Linen tea towel, botanical print
products.summary: Stonewashed linen with a screen-printed tea-plant print.
products.description: Stonewashed European linen tea towel, screen-printed by hand with a camellia (tea plant) botanical. 50 x 70 cm.
